# Press Releases


Dario Presents New Research at ISPOR Europe 2026 Validating a Biometric-Driven Approach to Estimating Healthcare Cost Savings and ROI - Consistent with Published Benchmarks and Without Waiting for Claims Data


-


-


-


-


*New methodology addresses critical market need for a transparent, replicable model to estimate healthcare cost savings and ROI when medical claims data are unavailable or delayed*


*Further demonstrates Dario's economic value in support of new contract wins, contract renewals and expansion of existing customer relationships*


NEW YORK


, Nov. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[DarioHealth Corp.](https://www.dariohealth.com/) (NASDAQ: DRIO) (the "Company", "DarioHealth" or "Dario"), a leading AI-powered healthcare technology company transforming the management of chronic conditions, today announced the presentation of new research at[ISPOR Europe 2026](https://www.ispor.org/conferences-education/conferences/upcoming-conferences/ispor-europe-2026) , a leading international conference focused on health economics and outcomes research, held November 8–11 in Vienna, Austria. The research highlights Dario's methodology for estimating healthcare cost savings and return on investment ("ROI") based on biometric improvements achieved by members participating in digital chronic disease management programs.


The presentation, titled "Estimating Individual-Level Medical Cost Savings from Digital Chronic Disease Management: A Biometric-to-PMPM Proxy Methodology," was delivered by Yifat Hershcovitz, Ph.D., Vice President of Clinical and Scientific Affairs at DarioHealth. The research describes a retrospective model that translates observed changes in blood pressure, blood glucose and weight into projected reductions in healthcare expenditures using published medical cost data.


Dario's model addresses the need among health plans, employers and enterprise healthcare purchasers to link measurable clinical outcomes to estimated cost savings. Leveraging the model, Dario is able to provide customers with evidence of program value in support of purchasing decisions, contract renewals and expansion into additional conditions and populations – without waiting for medical claims data, which often take months to become available or may not be accessible.


"This is a powerful study that provides an evidence-based and replicable method to demonstrate the in-year cost savings that Dario delivers specific to cardiometabolic disease. Moreover, it quantifies how savings are amplified when multiple conditions are enrolled," said Erez Raphael, Chief Executive Officer of DarioHealth. "This research gives Dario clients a validated process to confirm that their investment in Dario for cardiometabolic health is delivering the cost savings they contracted for – without the added administrative costs, time or reliance on claims analysis when claims data are delayed or not available."


"One of the biggest challenges in demonstrating the economic value of digital health is the limited availability of timely medical claims data," said Yifat Hershcovitz, Ph.D., Vice President of Clinical and Scientific Affairs at DarioHealth. "Our methodology bridges that gap directly by translating observed changes in clinical measures into transparent, evidence-based estimates of potential healthcare savings. This gives healthcare purchasers a practical way to evaluate program performance and understand its potential financial impact."


**About DarioHealth Corp.**


DarioHealth (Nasdaq: DRIO) is an AI-powered healthcare technology company helping health plans, health systems and employers improve health outcomes while lowering the cost of care. The Company's integrated platform combines connected devices, personalized member engagement, AI-driven insights and provider-backed clinical care to support people living with conditions including diabetes, hypertension, weight management, musculoskeletal and behavioral health needs.


Powered by more than 13 billion proprietary longitudinal healthcare data points collected over more than a decade, Dario's AI platform personalizes care at the individual member level by analyzing biometric, clinical and behavioral data to deliver more timely and effective interventions. By combining engagement, clinical intelligence and care delivery within a single platform, Dario helps customers address multiple chronic conditions through one solution.
